name: Lenovo ThinkPad Universal USB-C Dock
source_title: Lenovo Support: ThinkPad Universal USB-C Dock Overview and Service Parts
excerpt: ThinkPad Universal USB-C Dock (40AY). Connects via USB-C cable. Requires DisplayPort Alt Mode. Provides 1x HDMI 2.0 port up to 4K@60Hz and 2x DisplayPort 1.4 ports. Supports dual 4K@60Hz displays via DP and HDMI. Delivers up to 65W host power charging with included 90W power adapter. 3x USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A ports, Gigabit Ethernet (RJ-45).

evidence_excerpts.category: Lenovo designates the device as a Universal USB-C Dock.
evidence_excerpts.host_connection: Connects to host system through attached USB-C cable.
evidence_excerpts.requires_usb_c_dp_alt_mode: Host system requires USB-C DisplayPort Alt Mode.
evidence_excerpts.hdmi_max_resolution: HDMI port supports resolution up to 3840 x 2160 (4K).
evidence_excerpts.hdmi_max_refresh_hz: HDMI supports 60Hz refresh rate at 4K resolution.
evidence_excerpts.pd_input_max_w: Powered by ThinkPad 90W Slim Tip AC adapter.
evidence_excerpts.pd_pass_through_max_w: Delivers up to 65W Power Delivery to attached notebook.
evidence_excerpts.display_configurations: Supports simultaneous dual external displays up to 3840x2160 at 60Hz across DP and HDMI in extended desktop topology.
